evidence.quote: With more than 60 years’ experience behind it, the company designs and manufactures a wide range of high-performance audio solutions to meet the most demanding requirements in touring, fixed installation and portable sound applications. || With an extensive distribution network spanning more than 120 countries and with over 140 qualified partners, FBT guarantees not only a strong global presence || from small events to large-scale live productions and from permanent installations to corporate and hospitality venues
